_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. bind_address 0.0.0.0 hosts the whole LAN so several PCs share one leaderboard; 127.0.0.1 is solo.
_ports_comment: Leave "ports" out to listen on each title's LSP ports (base+1..+6) and on 8800. A map sets the ports instead.
_games_comment: Per-game GameSpy identifiers, keyed by the lowercase wire gamename. Override or add titles here. secret_key and gameid are not read by the current GPCM/Auth/Sake path; they matter to a future ServerBrowser or enctypex path.
_titles_comment: Per-title values over the built-in ones. When the log names an unknown Section 8 gameid, add it to titles.section8.gameids.
_portal_comment: Read-only stats portal at http://<this PC>:portal_port/. portal_names maps a GameSpy uniquenick or profileid to a display name.
